trust_decision.summary: Whether the built-in debug/test HTML pages are mounted on the Appium HTTP server at all: decided once in configureServer() by whether a registerTestPages callback was supplied, and in server() by the APPIUM_ENABLE_LEGACY_TEST_PAGES env flag; the published fix does not add any escaping, it removes the default surface.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the /test/guinea-pig* routes, and this is the literal mount of that route family; grepping 'guinea-pig' lands here and then in the handler that builds the page.

fix_sites.entry_point: server() -> configureServer() (CLI `appium server`, any GET to the server root serves the fixture dir; `${basePath}/crash` and `${basePath}/produce_error`)
`STATIC_DIR` re-exported from the package root (packages/base-driver/lib/index.js:17), consumed by driver test setups

fix_sites.module_kind: general-purpose utility module (template compiler, no escaping, uses new Function + with)

fix_sites.entry_point: reached from the four app.all routes via guineaPigTemplate()
module load time; STATIC_DIR is computed from __dirname by locating the 'base-driver' path segment
APPIUM_ENABLE_LEGACY_TEST_PAGES env var, read once inside server()

fix_sites.module_kind: wrapper/composition that mounts favicon, static dir, crash routes and the four pages

fix_sites.entry_point: TEST_FIXTURES_DIR, exported as STATIC_DIR (new module lib/test-pages/static-dir.ts)
none public; compileLodashTemplate relocated out of lib/utils.ts (new module lib/test-pages/template.ts)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: compileLodashTemplate and STATIC_DIR are generic package utilities with no HTTP surface, so a solver reading a route-level XSS report can argue they are unrelated to the reported /test/guinea-pig* routes and leave them alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The test pages are a working fixture for driver end-to-end CI: when explicitly enabled they must still render live interpolation (echoed comment, injected throwError, server/client time, cookies, ?delay) and STATIC_DIR must still resolve and ship; removing or escaping the templates kills that opt-in path.

O6_input_shapes: query string ?throwError=<text> (single value, or repeated key which Express gives as an array and String() joins) reflected inside a <script> block: packages/base-driver/static/test/guinea-pig.html:11-12
urlencoded POST body field 'comments' parsed by bodyParser.urlencoded({extended:true}) (string, or nested/array form) reflected into the HTML body: packages/base-driver/static/test/guinea-pig.html:50
request User-Agent header reflected into the HTML body: packages/base-driver/static/test/guinea-pig.html:87 and packages/base-driver/static/test/guinea-pig-app-banner.html:81
?delay=<n> is parsed with parseInt and cannot inject: packages/base-driver/lib/express/static.ts:36

mount-shape variants the fix itself handles: three route aliases plus /welcome and the raw static mount of the same fixture files, and enabled/disabled configuration via registerTestPages and env values 1/true/yes in any case: fix.diff:171-177

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A fourth built-in page (e.g. /test/guinea-pig-frames) registered next to the existing three and rendering request query/header values through the same template loader.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fixture directory already holds frameset.html, iframes.html, shadow-dom.html and touch.html that no dynamic route exposes, and maintainers have repeatedly added variants (scrollable, app-banner).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second echo of a request field into the page - the jumpContact form in the template posts 'fbemail' and 'comments', so a handler variant that echoes fbemail (or a JSON body field) into the HTML is a natural next line.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The form and textarea already exist in guinea-pig.html:62-74 and only 'comments' is consumed, so a maintainer adding an email echo would land one line from the sink.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second consumer of compileLodashTemplate in another package (e.g. a plugin rendering an HTML report from session data) rather than in base-driver's express layer.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The compiler is a generic exported utility in a shared module with no HTTP naming, so any package needing simple templating would import it.

O9_family: Reflected XSS / arbitrary JS from unescaped lodash-style template interpolation in built-in debug/test HTTP pages (CWE-79), compounded by active debug code and test endpoints exposed by default (CWE-489)

O10_build.toolchain: npm workspaces + lerna, tsc -b project references, mocha + ts-node for tests, tsd for type tests
O10_build.project_tests: packages/base-driver unit suite via `npm run -w packages/base-driver test:unit` (mocha "./test/unit/**/*.spec.ts"): packages/base-driver/test/unit/express/server.spec.ts:60-66 asserts app.use/app.all mount counts, packages/base-driver/test/unit/express/static.spec.ts:17-25 renders welcome.html from disk; e2e suites in packages/base-driver/test/e2e.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: HTML/JS-escape throwError, comment and userAgent inside guineaPigTemplate and leave all four pages (and the static fixture mount) served by default.

out_of_scope_notes: packages/base-driver/lib/index.js:17 still exports STATIC_DIR (repointed to test-fixtures by the fix) for external drivers such as appium-uiautomator2-driver/xcuitest-driver to mount these same pages in their own servers; those repositories are out of scope and were not inspected.

The same gate also closes ${basePath}/produce_error and ${basePath}/crash, unauthenticated endpoints that deliberately throw/crash the server; noted only, not pursued beyond this advisory's XSS property.
unverified: Repository size in MB (repo_mb) - no shell available, so tiny_repo/giant_repo could not be measured; the tree is a 21-package TypeScript monorepo with no node_modules, so neither extreme seems plausible.
